data.title: US senators call on Pete Hegseth to take accountability regarding USS Lincoln | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Criticizing Hegseth and US President Donald Trump for dismissing the reports, the senators argued that the situation on Lincoln was "preventable" and similar to issues USS Gerald R. Ford faced.
